_note: Synthetic-data demonstration rule set. Thresholds come from the cited public sources, but the rule set is NOT validated for clinical use and every flag is for a qualified professional to review. Reference bands marked illustrative are generic adult values for display only.

kdigo_g.title: KDIGO 2012 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD: GFR categories G1-G5

nice_ng203.title: NICE NG203 Chronic kidney disease: assessment and management (accelerated progression: sustained decrease in GFR of 25% or more and a change in GFR category within 12 months, or a sustained decrease of 15 ml/min/1.73 m2 per year)

fosamax_label.title: FOSAMAX (alendronate) US prescribing information, 5.6 Renal Impairment: not recommended for creatinine clearance less than 35 mL/min

fda_metformin_2016.title: FDA Drug Safety Communication (2016): metformin contraindicated at eGFR below 30; starting not recommended at eGFR 30-45

ada_2026_s6.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026, Section 6: assess glycemic status at least two times a year (6.2); A1C goal <7% appropriate for many nonpregnant adults, individualised (6.3a)

acei_k.title: ACE inhibitors (e.g. lisinopril prescribing information, Hyperkalemia warning) can raise serum potassium

reconciliation.title: Medication reconciliation: an 'active' medication with no prescription in the last 12 months should be confirmed with the patient

record_hygiene.title: Record reconciliation check (internal rule): duplicate or conflicting entries need a clinician to resolve
